facts.fact: 仪式办在许多年前改变他命运的那间毫无特征的空房里，是一个绕回原点的闭环。
facts.anchor: It feels like a full-circle moment, holding this ceremony in the same featureless room where my destiny was changed all those years ago.

facts.fact: 在场的三人他只「几乎肯定」是杀人犯、政客和那个始终问不出本名的落魄女人，而且全都没有脸。
facts.anchor: In fact, these Reapers—who I am almost positive are the murderer, the politician, and the bedraggled woman whose former name I never managed to learn—have no faces at all.

facts.fact: 他最后听说那个政客几十年前因极度不服从被降职，如今替 Lucifer 削铅笔。
facts.anchor: The last I heard, the politician was demoted decades ago for extreme insubordination—no big surprise there; fuck politicians, honestly—and now sharpens pencils for Lucifer.

facts.fact: 因为那政客没有戴标记 Lucifer 秘书班的永久项圈，他怀疑「替 Lucifer 削铅笔」只是传言。
facts.anchor: Though given that he’s here and isn’t wearing the permanent neck chain that marks Lucifer’s secretarial pool, perhaps this was just a rumor.

facts.fact: CEO 为擅自改动客座名单致歉，可听上去一点也不像道歉。
facts.anchor: The CEO clears his throat. “Apologies for taking liberties with the guest list,” he says to me, not sounding apologetic at all.

facts.fact: 这套仪式所依据的只有理论与猜测。
facts.anchor: And so we are basing all this on nothing but theory and guesswork.

facts.fact: CEO 举起双手，宣布仪式开始。
facts.anchor: “All right,” he says, raising his hands. “Let us begin.”

facts.fact: 仪式启动的那一刻，他闭上眼，脑子里只想 Lucy。
facts.anchor: I close my eyes and think only of Lucy.
